pages.text: Charging, it shows its way - get off it. A colossus at full tilt and a pillar are a bad mix for the colossus, and the vault over the pillar does not like being shaken.$(br2)When it roars, ice falls from the ceiling. That ice does not choose whom it falls on.
The wall of snow can be crossed - if you roll through it. Nobody walks out of its grip.$(br2)When it falls it leaves its head. The chronicle has a separate chapter on it.
